[View the ADEQ Hourly Forecast for Yuma]
A passing weather system will bring breezy to windy conditions today and Saturday. Additional breeziness is anticipated Monday Tuesday with the passage of a weak weather system. Other

areas.ag: Imperial County Air Pollution Control District
areas.t: Today, a temperature inversion will confine pollutants near the surface early in the day. In addition, light and variable winds will hinder dispersion in the Imperial Valley, leading to low-Moderate AQI levels.  Tomorrow, as a surface ridge of high pressure strengthens to the north, light northweste
